rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides structured access to six Norwegian government cybersecurity frameworks including NSM Grunnprinsipper, Digdir Digital Security Guidelines, and Sikkerhetsloven. Features full-text search across 262 controls, bilingual Norwegian/English support, ISO 27002:2022 cross-references, and sector-based filtering. Available as npm package or remote Vercel endpoint.
